Human detection

AI features

Cameras that watch for you, not just record

Ordinary CCTV shows you what happened after the fact. AI-enabled cameras and recorders analyse the picture themselves and send an alert the moment something important happens, so you can act in time. These features come with selected camera and recorder models, and we help you choose the right ones.

Human detection

Tells people apart from animals, vehicles, swaying trees and passing shadows, so the alerts you get are about people and false alarms drop, especially at night.

How an alert works

From detection to action in four steps

Detect

The camera spots a person, fire, a crowd or a line crossing.

Alert

Your phone gets a notification with a snapshot.

Alarm

A siren or light goes off at the site to scare off intruders.

Review

Open the recorded clip and see exactly what happened.

Detection quality depends on camera position, lighting and the model chosen. We set up and tune each zone on site.

Good to know

Questions customers ask about AI CCTV

Does AI CCTV need internet?

Recording happens on your recorder, so it continues without internet. Phone alerts and remote live view need an internet connection, so we recommend a stable broadband line at the site.

Will I still get false alarms?

Far fewer than with plain motion detection, but never zero. Lighting, camera angle and distance affect accuracy. We set up each detection zone on site and adjust it after you have used the system for a few days.

Can my existing cameras get AI features?

It depends on the camera and recorder. AI analytics usually run in the camera or in a supported recorder. We check your current equipment during the site visit and tell you what can stay and what needs upgrading.

What about privacy?

Point cameras at your own property and avoid private areas. Put up a notice that CCTV is in use. Face recognition stores facial data, so use it only for people who know about it and keep the list small. Data protection rules in India are still developing, so we advise you on placement and on how long to keep recordings.

How much does it cost?

AI cameras cost more than basic ones, and the price depends on the number of cameras, recorder size and the features you want. Message us for a quote after we know your site. Subscribed customers get 20% off on materials.

What goes wrong without planning

Six problems we solve in every room

Most disappointing home theatres have the same causes. We plan around each of them before buying anything.

Choosing the right equipment

Screen, projector, speakers and receiver matched to your room size, how you watch and your budget.

Weak or muddy sound

Speakers placed and set up so dialogue stays clear and bass stays balanced.

Awkward room layout

A layout built around your walls, doors and windows, with seats at the right distance.

Messy cables

Wiring hidden and organised, so nothing hangs behind the screen or across the floor.

Washed-out picture

A screen and lighting plan that keeps the image bright and clear in your room.

Poor installation

Professional mounting, connection and calibration so every part works together.

Sound layout

Speakers placed where they matter

A typical 5.1 setup puts three speakers across the front, two beside the seats and a subwoofer near the screen. We adjust the plan to your room, then calibrate the levels at the seating position.

  • Clear dialogueThe centre speaker sits on the screen line so voices come from the picture.
  • Surround that wraps aroundSide speakers add effects without overpowering the front.
  • Balanced bassSubwoofer position tested in the room, because small moves change the result.
